999008199.text:
ただいま戻りました。
無数島群域西部の調査を終えてきました

localizations.en: I'm back. I've finished surveying the western region of the Infinite Island Chain.
Linca

999008199.text:
おかえりなさい、リンカ。
早速だけど、現地の様子を報告してくれる？

localizations.en: Welcome back, Linca. I know you just got here, but could you report on the situation?
Marion

999008199.text:
はい。新たに開通した海路は順調です。島々の住民も、
ランターナの人々の出入りには慣れてきたようでした

localizations.en: Yes. The newly opened sea routes are operating smoothly. The island residents seem to have grown accustomed to people from Lantarna coming and going.
Linca

999008199.text: そう……私たち異邦人の行動範囲も広がったわけね

localizations.en: I see... So the areas we wanderers can reach have expanded as well.
Marion

999008199.text: はい。今後は、より広域の情報整理が必要になるかと

localizations.en: Yes. Going forward, we'll need to organize information across a much wider area.
Linca

999008199.text:
まったく、今までランターナ王国内だけで
手一杯だったのに、無数島群域まで加わるなんて……

localizations.en: Just when I thought keeping track of everything within Lantarna was already too much, now we have to add the Infinite Island Chain on top of it...
Marion

999008199.text: 報告書の山が減る気がしないわ

localizations.en: I don't see this mountain of reports getting any smaller.
Marion

999008199.text:
ぼやいてる暇があったら手を動かしなさい。
そんなことしたって仕事は減らないんだから

localizations.en: If you have time to complain, use your hands. Whining won't make the work go away.
Cordelia

999008199.text:
本当に助かってるわ、クーデリアちゃん。
あなたが来てくれてから、仕事が倍速で進むもの

localizations.en: You've been such a huge help, Cordelia. Ever since you arrived, I've been getting through work twice as fast.
Marion

999008199.text:
しかし、クーデリアは貴族だと聞きました。
なぜこのような仕事に慣れているのでしょう？

localizations.en: However, I heard you were nobility. Why are you so skilled at this kind of work?
Linca

999008199.text:
貴族かどうかなんて関係ないわよ。
できる人はできる、それだけのことじゃない

localizations.en: Being a noble has nothing to do with it. People who can get things done, get things done. That's all there is to it.
Cordelia

999008199.text:
ただいま戻りました！　マリオンさん、
調べてきたことを報告します

localizations.en: I'm back! Marion, I've got my report ready!
Firis

999008199.text:
おかえりなさい、フィリスちゃん。
今回はどこを回ってきたの？

localizations.en: Welcome back, Firis. Where did you go this time?
Marion

999008199.text:
えっと……レスナちゃんたちが行ったっていう
オーベンランドまで！

localizations.en: Um... All the way to Aubenland, where Resna and the others went!
Firis

999008199.text:
ちょっと待って、それって前回の報告とぜんぜん
違う場所じゃない！　まさか、そんな大移動を……？

localizations.en: Hold on, that's nowhere near where you were last time! Don't tell me you traveled all that way...?
Cordelia

999008199.text:
はい。人々の最北の到達点……
どんな場所か気になって、つい

localizations.en: I did! The northernmost point people have ever reached... I just had to see what it was like.
Firis

999008199.text: フィリスの行動力には驚かされます

localizations.en: Firis's mobility never ceases to amaze me.
Linca

999008199.text:
はあ……こうして報告を受けているだけだと、
みんなが今どこに居るのか、掴みづらいのよね

localizations.en: I swear... When all I have to go on are these reports, it's hard to keep track of where everyone actually is.
Marion

999008199.text:
ほんとよ。みんな好き勝手に動き回ってるんだもの。
受け取った情報の整理だけじゃ追いつかないわ

localizations.en: Tell me about it. Everyone's running around doing whatever they please. We can barely keep up just organizing the information we get.
Cordelia

999008199.text:
常に全員の位置を把握できる方法があれば、
もっと効率的なんだけど

localizations.en: If only there were some way to know where everyone is at all times. That would make things so much more efficient.
Marion

999008199.text:
うーん……
何かいい方法、ないかなあ

localizations.en: Hmm... I wonder if there's a good solution.
Firis

999008199.text:
地図にみんながいる場所の印を付けてくれる
道具でもあれば、楽になりそうですね

localizations.en: If we had a tool that could mark everyone's locations on a map, that would make things much easier.
Linca

999008199.text:
なに言ってるの……って思ったけど、
もし本当にできるのなら悪くないわね

localizations.en: I was about to say that's nonsense... but actually, if we could really do that, it wouldn't be such a bad idea.
Marion

999008199.text:
錬金術士たちが力を合わせれば、
もしかしてもしかするかもしれないわ

localizations.en: If the alchemists all worked together, it just might be possible.
Cordelia

999008199.text:
わたしも協力するよ！　
みんなの居場所が分かれば、もっと安心できるもん

localizations.en: I'll help out too! If we could know where everyone is, it'd be so much more reassuring!
Firis

999008199.text:
そうね、みんなの力を合わせて、
もっといい管理方法を考えましょう

localizations.en: You're right. Let's put our heads together and figure out a better way to manage all this.
Marion
